brief.zh: 知道当初加的是哪份噪声 ε，把原图 x₀ 还原出来。
brief.en: Knowing which noise ε was added, get the original picture x₀ back.

hint.zh: 把加噪的公式倒过来解 x₀。
hint.en: Solve the noise formula backwards for x₀.

after.zh: 只要知道噪声，原图一步就能还原。扩散模型要学的正是这件事：看着 x_t 猜出 ε。猜得越准，还原得越好。
after.en: Know the noise and the original comes back in one step. This is exactly what a diffusion model learns: looking at x_t, guess ε. The better the guess, the better the restoration.

t.zh: 加噪是往前走。生成一张图要往回走：从噪声里把图找回来。
t.en: Adding noise goes forwards. Generating a picture goes backwards: finding the picture again in the noise.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：知道当初加的是哪份噪声，把原图还原出来。
t.en: Your task in this level: knowing which noise was added, get the original picture back.

eps.en: The noise ε that was added

desc.zh: 输出 (x_t − √(1 − ᾱ)·ε) / √ᾱ：由 x_t 和噪声 ε 还原 x₀。
desc.en: Outputs (x_t − √(1 − ᾱ)·ε) / √ᾱ: x₀ recovered from x_t and the noise ε.
